unlisted_practices: Using an LLM-based near-real-time weekly provincial dashboard to monitor time-to-decompression for traumatic spinal cord injury
Provincial multidisciplinary working group to develop a best practice recommendation and a monitoring and learning approach

screen.reason: Describes the operational deployment of an LLM-driven provincial dashboard for near-real-time quality monitoring of time-to-decompression in traumatic SCI, but does not formally test a specific deployment practice/guardrail.
